_readme: Aspendora fork changelog shown at /cipp/whats-new. Newest first. Add an entry in the same commit/PR as any user-visible fork feature (see docs/aspendora-whats-new.md). Fields: id (unique kebab-case), date (YYYY-MM-DD, the day it went live), title, area (one of the listed areas), summary (1-3 plain sentences: what it does for the operator), optional path (page in CIPP), optional ref (Vikunja card / ticket).

entries.title: Vendor Access report and weekly email
entries.summary: Tenant > Reports > Vendor Access lists every outside party with standing access across all tenants: apps from other organisations (permissions, risk, new credentials, last sign-in), other partners' GDAP/DAP groups holding directory roles, guests holding roles and cross-tenant service providers, with stale (45+ days) and new-this-week flags. A summary is emailed every Monday at 07:00 Central.

entries.title: Risky app permissions alert can be set up
entries.summary: The 'Alert on apps holding over-privileged API permissions' alert (App Permission Exposure) now appears in the alert list, with minimum level, categories, delegated and Microsoft-app options. MSP Process was added to the known vendor list.

entries.title: Sharing digest skips links shared only with yourself
entries.summary: The weekly OneDrive sharing digest no longer counts a 'specific people' link whose only recipient is the OneDrive's owner, so nobody gets an email about sharing that reaches no one. The email now always links OneDrive's Shared view and offers to remove shares on request by reply.

entries.title: Sharing scan progress and item permissions
entries.summary: Finished libraries in a sharing-links scan now keep their item count and scan mode in the scan status, instead of showing 0. ListGraphRequest can read the permissions of a single OneDrive or library item (drives/{id}/items/{id}/permissions) so a removed share can be confirmed live; file contents and folder listings stay blocked.

entries.title: User sign-in logs accept an email address
entries.summary: ListUserSigninLogs now works when given a user's sign-in name (UPN) instead of their object ID. Before, a UPN never matched and the request timed out.

entries.title: What's New (Aspendora)
entries.summary: This page. Lists features our fork adds on top of upstream CIPP, newest first. The account menu shows a dot when something was added since your last visit.

entries.title: Run approved ControlR scripts from CIPP
entries.summary: CIPP can run scripts from the ControlR approved list on managed devices (API endpoint ExecControlRApprovedScript, Aspendora tenant only for now; no page yet).

entries.title: Conditional Access: plan detection and break-glass exclusion alert
entries.summary: Detects each tenant's Conditional Access licence level, alerts when a policy loses its break-glass exclusion, and reports restricted management administrative unit posture.

entries.title: Our own audited changes land as ticket notes
entries.summary: When an audit alert matches a change we made for an open ConnectWise ticket, it is added as a note on that ticket instead of opening a new one. Role-grant alerts open at most one ticket per tenant per hour.

entries.title: Entra ID P1/P2 true-up
entries.summary: Report, weekly alert and test comparing Entra ID P1/P2 licences with the users who need them. Package accounts are left out; inactive accounts are flagged.

entries.title: Alerts read as the app when the delegated user lacks roles
entries.summary: Graph reads behind alerts retry with the CIPP app token when the partner user has no roles in the tenant, so alerts keep working.

entries.title: Session timeline
entries.summary: One timeline of a user's sign-ins and activity for incident review.

entries.title: Sign-in failure explainer
entries.summary: Explains why a sign-in failed in plain language, with the likely fix.

entries.title: What Changed (posture diff)
entries.summary: Shows what changed in a tenant's security posture between two points in time.

entries.title: Entra recovery coverage
entries.summary: Shows which Entra objects Microsoft's Entra backup covers in each tenant.

entries.title: Message Center digest
entries.summary: Microsoft 365 Message Center posts filtered to what matters for our tenants.

entries.title: Exchange provisioning check
entries.summary: Finds licensed users whose mailbox did not provision, and why.

entries.title: Out-of-office exposure
entries.summary: Lists out-of-office replies sent to external senders and can limit one to known senders.

entries.title: Teams file resolver
entries.summary: Finds where a file shared in Teams actually lives.

entries.title: Cloud-only lint
entries.summary: Flags Intune settings that assume on-premises AD in cloud-only tenants.

entries.title: Personal (BYOD) device enrollment
entries.summary: Shows personal devices and how they are enrolled.

entries.title: SMS/voice MFA readiness
entries.summary: Finds users who still rely on SMS or voice MFA and are not ready for it to be turned off.

entries.title: Guest inventory and Guest Access Review
entries.summary: Every guest account with who invited it and when it was last used, plus a Guest Access Review PDF.

entries.title: Standard: hide 'Stay signed in?'
entries.summary: New standard DisableKeepMeSignedIn turns off the 'Stay signed in?' prompt.

entries.title: Verified, diffable backups with safe restore-as-new
entries.summary: CIPP backups are checked after they run, can be compared, and can be restored as new objects instead of overwriting.

entries.title: Abused-TLD blocking and mail delivery triage
entries.summary: Tenant allow/block templates for commonly abused top-level domains with an exposure audit, and a triage tool that explains why a message was or wasn't delivered.

entries.title: Intune: enrollment discovery, operational alerts, driver updates
entries.summary: Autopilot enrollment status pages, Intune operational alerts, Intune hygiene and a driver update standard.

entries.title: Defender hardening pack and pending AIR alert
entries.summary: Defender hardening standards and an alert when automated investigation remediations are waiting for approval.

entries.title: Sharing-burst detection and email security change alerts
entries.summary: Alerts on sudden bursts of external sharing and on changes to email security settings.

entries.title: Least-privilege role report
entries.summary: Lists admin role assignments and where a smaller role would do.

entries.title: Conditional Access pre-flight lockout check
entries.summary: Before a CA policy is saved, checks it would not lock out admins or break-glass accounts.

entries.title: CA baseline, OIB drift and effective Intune policy
entries.summary: Report-only CA baseline, drift against the Open Intune Baseline, and the policies that actually apply to a device or user.

entries.title: OAuth grant risk scoring
entries.summary: Scores app consent grants by risk and alerts on high-risk grants, with fleet-wide and per-tenant allow-lists.

entries.title: Phishing-resistant MFA report
entries.summary: Report and weekly alert on admins without phishing-resistant MFA.

entries.title: Break-glass account registry and posture
entries.summary: Register each tenant's break-glass accounts, get alerted when one signs in or changes, and see a weekly posture check.

entries.title: EWS status report and pin
entries.summary: Shows Exchange Web Services status per tenant ahead of Microsoft's shutdown, with a one-click pin and a daily alert.

entries.title: GDAP health monitor
entries.summary: Daily check of GDAP relationships and CIPP tokens, with run-now, one-click auto-extend and an ignore list. Alerts reach ConnectWise.

entries.title: Weekly OneDrive sharing digest
entries.summary: Emails each user a weekly list of the links they have shared from OneDrive (Managed Clients only).

entries.title: Reset passwords documented in Hudu
entries.summary: Passwords from user creation and resets are delivered through Password Pusher and saved to the client's Hudu passwords (previously IT Glue).

entries.title: Copy or move mailbox and OneDrive content
entries.summary: Copy or move mail (including the online archive) and OneDrive files from one user to another, with resume that doesn't duplicate.

entries.title: CompromiseSweep alert
entries.summary: Scripted alert that sweeps tenants for common account-compromise signs.

entries.title: Azure subscription compliance
entries.summary: Checks client Azure subscriptions against a security baseline using a Reader grant.

entries.title: Mailbox reads through the Graph proxies
entries.summary: ListGraphRequest/ExecGraphRequest can read mailboxes for investigations (fork exemption from the upstream blocklist).

entries.title: Windows 365 Cloud PCs
entries.summary: Cloud PC inventory, provisioning policies and lifecycle actions, with guards on destructive actions.

entries.title: Intune insights
entries.summary: Policy conflicts as Intune computed them, reverse assignment lookup, deployment outcome counts, malware detail, stale devices, update ring health and per-device feature update alerts.

entries.title: Consent-blocked user alerts
entries.summary: Opens tickets for users blocked by app consent and for pending admin consent requests.

entries.title: Printers
entries.summary: Universal Print and direct-IP printer management, a printer catalogue standard, readiness report, deployment status and failure alert.

entries.title: Teams policies and voice apps
entries.summary: Browse Teams policies and voice apps, capture policies as templates and enforce them across tenants on a schedule.

entries.title: M365 storage and usage trending
entries.summary: Mailbox, OneDrive and SharePoint storage trends with a report and alerting for managed clients.

entries.title: Managed/unmanaged tenant groups from ConnectWise
entries.summary: Tenant groups follow the client's ConnectWise agreement instead of being set by hand.

entries.title: New-hire welcome packet
entries.summary: Printable welcome packet and welcome email for new users in cloud-only tenants.

entries.title: Defender custom indicators
entries.summary: Manage Microsoft Defender for Endpoint custom indicators (block/allow IPs, URLs, files) across tenants.

entries.title: Aspendora fork baseline
entries.summary: Carried over from the original fork: Autopatch management, the report suite (Tools > Reports) with scheduled email, Pax8 and our ConnectWise integration, and the ExecGraphRequest/ExecExoRequest passthroughs used by the CIPP MCP.
